text.c0dd281b7b3ee: A narrow tunnel leads into the stump. A wheel of cheese lies ahead.
text.c5c1651b6e324: A stone slab blocks the way. A handle on the door can be turned.
text.cbdc5834e638d: A pond sits in the courtyard. Ladders lead to houses in the stump.
text.cf9c2c15570ea: The room has been ransacked. Household utensils lie scattered about.
text.ce908e611276b: A quiet old house with a festival painting on the wall.
text.c52b0271be201: Thick, sticky webs obscure the room. Faint movements come from within.
text.cf75b32db0027: Barrels and clutter fill the broad hall. You can hear movement inside.
text.cabbc11e7cc7a: The equipment suggests this room was used to make cheese.
text.c468815587ef0: Iron gates divide the space. A faint scraping comes from beyond.
text.cb8129ac050be: Wheels of aging cheese fill the cave with a rich smell.
text.cfa73b1069a51: Light one-handed weapon. Check usage after combat.
text.c5f7df239d3f5: Spends one use every six exploration turns while lit.
text.c939d2ab79040: For climbing and securing objects. The Keeper decides whether risky use requires a usage check.
text.c999908d61a55: Occupies the off hand and one body slot. Reduces damage by 1 while equipped and usable. Check usage after combat.
text.c0ad0b8aedbd5: Adventure item. Value follows the location reference; slot size awaits final source verification.
text.cfacab0d4ff12: Treasure from the courtyard pond; occupies four slots.
text.cefd3e6d12b27: Utensils from the ransacked house, worth 10p each.
text.ca84fe9bb26d6: Its effect on the guard snake follows the scene ruling. Value pending verification.
text.ca409f4bc2a70: A tool from the cheese factory. Other uses require a Keeper ruling.
text.c3c3e5ae85823: Filter cloth from the cheese factory.
text.c6fa4391e58a2: Occupies one slot. The Keeper removes it after the required recovery.
text.c25fea87645b6: Occupies one slot. Consult the rules and Keeper for recovery requirements.
text.c1740bed11513: The Keeper supplies and adjudicates spell effects, usage and recharge requirements.
text.c65434e89817f: A light source with six uses.
text.ca1baabf64fda: Inspect the marks without touching anything.
text.ccc54781abe6e: Inspect it before deciding whether to take it.
text.c89a0cb765a91: No roll; identify the connection and danger.

text.c0513ded4ecf3: An armed trap causes d12 damage. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c49a92ba8d452: Examine the frame and hinges for a way to open it.
text.cb248421b8367: Prepare a safe opening or risk turning the handle directly.
text.c26909a647ad4: Requires prior inspection and usable rope. Costs one rope use and one exploration turn.
text.cb96a3a90de4e: An armed trap rolls d20 damage. A Dexterity save halves it before armour. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c11d1aae73f53: Look underwater or dive for discovered objects.
text.c29f9ca01d26f: Dexterity save; failure causes d4 damage, success recovers finite coins. Costs one exploration turn.
text.cc0b5d4cfc979: Dexterity save; failure causes d4 damage, success places a four-slot item. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c9c4a269a1c4e: No roll; reveal visible adjacent locations.
text.c006e27c6f954: The search creates finite stock. Repeated inspection does not reroll it.
text.c0e8c4b4119c1: The first search rolls d6 for stock and costs one exploration turn.
text.c28027e69feb7: Take one from remaining stock and place it in an available slot.
text.c838bc81ac2d0: Study the painting for clues about the courtyard.
text.c1d1a662f1d1d: No roll; add the clue to your records.
text.cd4401ba96cc3: Examine the webs and movement from outside.
text.c3f72dd3e3309: No roll; record the danger and trapped villagers.
text.c35744e4907ac: Contact the trapped villagers or cut them free with a weapon.
text.c312cc6b61145: Avoid the webs and cut them free
text.c427e08bee6be: Requires a usable weapon. Dexterity save; failure causes d6 venom damage (overflow reduces Dexterity). Costs one exploration turn.
text.c03483ec6b6c5: Observe the gang, clutter and rear door.
text.c82abea328fba: The first observation rolls 2d6 for gang size; the number persists.
text.cb7fb64b7fe3d: Seek permission to pass and trade.
text.cd403c0233544: Willpower save; one verbal attempt per encounter. Costs one exploration turn.
text.ce98a847efc76: Spend one ration use for passage and the flute. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c2a982beed82c: Inspect the equipment and portable tools.
text.c1f4ac403f3c6: No roll; record the equipment and response.
text.cb195729af161: Take finite stock and automatically occupy two slots.
text.c338dbf6482ec: Take finite stock and place it in an available slot.
text.cd0a5b4a946da: Inspect doors, the lift and roof hatch.
text.ce384bfe72334: No roll; reveal adjacent routes and record the hatch.
text.cc5dfdb732fc9: Open the gate to the snake cage
text.c0aff976a6b91: Unbar this side to open the route. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c3d4d75141c13: Take the lift to the courtyard
text.c320e62547cad: Travel to the courtyard. Costs one exploration turn.
text.cad62e51dd934: Inspect the cave gate and its guard.
text.c764643fabfde: No roll; record the guard and exit conditions.
text.c97f3fe2130ea: Open while the guard is calm
text.cfe5acf217d06: Requires a calmed snake; opens the cave route.
text.c6f56be7a4cb9: Identify the snake and choose an approach.
text.c8db99ff9e0db: No roll; record the guard's movements.
text.c9e5666b6b1cf: Requires the flute; calms the guard snake. Costs one exploration turn.
text.cba40df1562bf: Sneak past and open the gate
text.c3970135f402f: Dexterity save; failure causes d8 bite damage. Costs one exploration turn.
text.ceb588c3c829b: Count the stock and decide whether to take any.
text.cdc67dc65dc31: Take freely with permission; otherwise make a Dexterity save or wake the sleeper. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c0ccdcd783c7c: Observe Ernie or ask where the villagers went.
text.c6e16b09420b9: No roll; record the sleeper's state.
text.cbe07ecd01685: Wake gently and ask about the villagers
text.c043d3f39ec01: Record the northern outpost clue and gain permission to take cheese. Costs one exploration turn.
text.c55ef1f09ac2a: After armour, took {damage} damage; {hp} HP remaining.
text.c9aac89eac670: You are incapacitated and must recover before acting.
text.c838fdda43ecf: All slots are occupied. The item stays here until you make room.
text.c7dd3d69a8097: Falling rocks marked the floor. The cheese is connected to a trigger; taking it directly is dangerous.
text.c54f91f321555: There are {count} gang members, a locked door behind the barrels and a snake flute beside the clutter.
text.c02e5924c2d41: The gang grants passage and includes the flute in the trade.
text.ca426d7d4cf4a: You avoid the marks, identify the cheese's connection to the rocks above, and find the route to the main gate.
text.c63dab068d09d: The cheese is bait. You record the trigger's position without setting it off.
text.c29cf0ea6db54: The cheese has already been taken.
text.c79b4ef31d014: No slots are available. The cheese stays here.
text.cb7077612816a: Inspect the cheese or ground to identify the connection before disarming it.
text.c1c7e1af8ff63: You safely disconnect the trigger. The rocks do not fall.
text.caf6833363654: The rocks have fallen. The trap cannot trigger again.
text.c2b86f5e1f233: The entrance trap is spent. The cheese is safe to take.
text.ca5f64eec9dbe: Turning the handle tips the slab. The frame has points where rope can secure it.
text.caf6859e9ba22: Secure it with rope before turning the handle, or dodge the slab when opening directly.
text.c14dbacfb8c4c: The stone door is open. You can enter the courtyard.
text.c730fc535c773: Inspect the handle and frame first to find securing points.
text.c6e6b410a506f: Usable rope is needed to brace the slab. You may instead open it directly.
text.cf77532664a07: Braced the slab; spent one use from slot {slot}.
text.cdc8b4ce21f6a: Successful save; slab damage is halved.
text.c33ba5622c983: The stone door opens. The courtyard and its routes appear on your map.
text.c85004ddc7709: A gold-leaf mouse statue and a pouch lie underwater. The statue needs four slots; the pouch holds 140p.
text.cd84b25bc599e: The pond holds a four-slot statue and a coin pouch; only remaining stock can be taken.
text.c578d7184e1ac: Inspect the pond bed before choosing what to recover.
text.c4a3cdbd6f73d: This treasure has already been taken.
text.c1dd1d4ccec97: There is no room for the statue. It remains in the pond.
text.cd332e55a4261: The current pushes you ashore. The treasure remains below.
text.c5687c9109f58: Ladders lead to three houses; paths connect the hall and cheese factory. These locations are now mapped.
text.c79b09f71be45: The painting shows a golden mouse statue in the courtyard, matching the object in the pond.
text.cd861d7aea1de: The painting records a courtyard festival. The statue in the pond once stood in the courtyard.
text.cb96c87a67d5c: The painting shows an old courtyard festival featuring a mouse statue.
text.cb228691a8086: Two spiders move deep in the webs, with two villagers trapped behind them. Observing from afar leaves them undisturbed.
text.c3381e3da17b1: Roquefort and Paneer are trapped. A usable weapon could cut them free.
text.c468a8bbf412f: Roquefort and Paneer whisper back, pointing out strands you could cut.
text.c507768c05cfa: Both villagers can still move. Their bonds can be cut, but spiders are nearby.
text.c333f08cd5d0a: Both villagers are already free and waiting safely in the courtyard.
text.ccf7026a76b19: This rescue requires a needle sword with uses remaining.
text.cbfc25c31ed44: Avoid the webs and cut the bonds
text.c201ced0766b1: The bonds are cut. Both villagers descend the ladder to the courtyard.
text.c610a79fe0d51: The rescue succeeds. Both villagers retreat to the courtyard.
text.cce902051dce9: The web alerts the spiders. The rescue is not complete.
text.ce43ec9ee9e2e: The gang still honours the earlier passage agreement.
text.cc19b46f59be5: Offered food; spent one ration use from slot {slot}.
text.c160bee7f2125: The gang already rejected this argument. Offer food instead; repeated attempts do not reroll.
text.c8ac27bc8d17d: Persuade the gang to allow passage
text.c7016b142690c: The gang refuses passage but will trade for food. The rear door stays locked and the flute remains with them.
text.ce13dac30e820: Jack explains the paddle, cloth and lift, and permits you to take the remaining tools.
text.c655144d00bf7: The factory has finite paddles and cloth. The lift returns to the courtyard.
text.cc153c16404bf: Inspect the equipment and ask Jack first.
text.c4a1a0a7bc7fb: You find the lift, gate to the snake cage and roof hatch. The hall door behind the barrels retains its current lock state.
text.cd344efe30b81: The lift leads to the courtyard, the iron gate to the snake cage, and the roof hatch outside.
text.ca9bcd05f3359: The gate to the snake cage is open.
text.c98566c294868: You ride the lift back to the courtyard.
text.c4ac66f860d69: The cave is beyond another gate. Calm the snake or risk sneaking past to reach the latch.
text.c61b7bc810385: The snake is not calm. Play the flute or choose to sneak past under Listen.
text.c43ac6cc2f6bb: You pass the calm snake and open the cave gate.
text.cd81268e3ff32: The breathing and scraping come from the same guard snake. It remains by the gate; no new snake appears.
text.c70cc2f0221f8: Calm the guard with the flute or risk sneaking past to open the cave gate.
text.c21be890b04f9: You need the snake flute. Return to the hall and negotiate for it.
text.cef353f0d6685: The flute calms the snake. You can now approach the gate.
text.c4735738af767: The cave gate is already open.
text.c06379ff59e01: Sneak past the snake to open the gate
text.c9af22a403596: You seize an opening and pull the latch. The route is open.
text.c6e196de60d2a: The snake blocks your way. The gate remains closed.
text.ccff2c8432b84: All cheese here has been taken.
text.cc0a3298c1412: No slots are available. The cheese remains here.

text.caa5caae87847: Take cheese without waking the sleeper

text.c2b28ea8007a8: Ernie is awake, watching the cave.
text.c1a7787eb0f56: Ernie is sleeping soundly. Moving cheese carelessly may wake him.
text.c0338f1b365b6: Ernie permits you to take cheese and points north toward the missing villagers. The clue is recorded.
text.c5b7893b2e247: The conversation points to an outpost to the north. You have found the next lead beyond Stumpsville.
text.cd356d70dc579: Investigation points to a northern outpost. The Keeper supplies details once discovery conditions are met; this stage ends here.
